headline: Saudi Arabia to Introduce 15% Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax in 2027
summary: Saudi Arabia announced a new domestic minimum top-up tax starting January 1, 2027, applying to local branches of multinational enterprises generating annual revenue of €750 million or more.
why: Saudi Arabia is implementing the OECD Pillar Two global minimum tax framework to align its corporate tax regime with international standards.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: The top-up tax targets multinational corporations operating in Saudi Arabia to ensure a 15% minimum effective rate.
